graduation_path.label: ad-astra-held-key
graduation_path.notes: See docs/SIGNING_V1.md sec.6. Graduation flips active_path to a new entry under paths and adds a corresponding algorithm + key-identity record. v0 sigstore signatures remain verifiable via the original path entry.

notes: This document is the single source of truth for the locked identity policy. Verifiers (CLI, downstream auditors, the trace verify command) read subject_regex + oidc_issuer from here rather than hard-coding them. If the Steward workflow path is ever renamed (e.g. .github/workflows/steward.yml -> .github/workflows/merge-gate.yml), update subject_regex here and downstream verifiers refresh from this file. Schema-version 1.0.0 is locked alongside docs/SIGNING_V1.md.
